        "quote": "The Rust core of [Omni](../../README.md): it runs processes and terminals with the same behavior on Windows, macOS and\nLinux. Callers build a `Command` (timeout, grace, cancel, pty and the rest) and call `run` or `spawn`. The crate never\ncreates a child itself: it asks the supervisor process to, so stopping a child ends its whole process tree."
      },

        "start_line": 17,
        "end_line": 28,
        "quote": "- `bindings/node` (`hugr-omni-node`), the native addon behind the `hugr-omni` npm package.\n- `qa` (the QA harness), which runs the same workloads through omni and through the standard library.\n- In Orchestra, `packages/core/src/omni.ts` is the only module that imports `hugr-omni`.\n\n## Build and test\n\nThe `omni` workflow (`.github/workflows/omni.yml`) runs `node scripts/ci.mjs`, which formats, lints with clippy and\nruns `cargo test --workspace` on Linux, Windows and macOS. Tests are in `tests/` (`contract.rs`, `teeth.rs`) and next to\nthe modules.\n\nThe promises are in [docs/api-contract.md](../../docs/api-contract.md) and the per-OS evidence in\n[GUARANTEES.md](../../GUARANTEES.md)."
      }

    "evidence": [
      {
        "start_line": 60,
        "end_line": 68,
        "quote": "    /// Windows only (amendment WP8b): the exact command line after the program, for a program that parses its own\n    /// command line (e.g. `cmd.exe` with `/d /s /c \"...\"`). The child's command line is `argv[0]` in quotes, a space\n    /// and `tail`, unchanged: no quoting, no escaping, and the library still adds no shell. It fails with\n    /// `InvalidArgument` on other systems, together with `arg`/`args`, with a NUL, or when the program resolves to a\n    /// `.cmd`/`.bat` (name `cmd.exe` yourself).\n    pub fn windows_verbatim_args(&mut self, tail: impl AsRef<OsStr>) -> &mut Self {\n        self.req.verbatim = Some(tail.as_ref().to_os_string());\n        self\n    }"
      },
      {
        "start_line": 146,
        "end_line": 159,
        "quote": "    /// `run()` only: per-stream limit (default 16 MiB); above it `run()` fails with `OutputLimit`.\n    pub fn max_output_bytes(&mut self, bytes: usize) -> &mut Self {\n        self.opts.max_output_bytes = bytes;\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// `spawn()` with pipes only (default `false`): while a consumer is attached and a stream has 16 MiB waiting\n    /// for it, the library stops reading that stream instead of dropping, so the pipe fills and the child blocks\n    /// on its writes; nothing is ever lost and no `lost_before` appears. With no consumer attached the usual\n    /// budget applies. `wait()` and `stop()` never depend on the consumer: `stop()` still ends the tree, and\n    /// detaching or stopping lets the output go. Ignored by `run()` and by terminals.\n    pub fn backpressure(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut Self {\n        self.opts.backpressure = yes;\n        self"
      },
      {
        "start_line": 168,
        "end_line": 190,
        "quote": "    /// Starts the process with pipes. Fails with `InvalidArgument` if `pty()` was set (use `spawn_pty()`).\n    pub fn spawn(&self) -> Result<PipeChild, Error> {\n        process::spawn_pipe(&self.request(self.pty), &self.opts)\n    }\n\n    /// Starts the process inside a terminal (the `pty()` size, or 80 x 24).\n    pub fn spawn_pty(&self) -> Result<PtyChild, Error> {\n        process::spawn_pty(&self.request(Some(self.pty.unwrap_or_default())), &self.opts)\n    }\n\n    /// Runs to completion and returns the exit status with the complete output (contract §6).\n    /// A non-zero exit is not an error.\n    pub async fn run(&self) -> Result<RunOutput, Error> {\n        process::run(&self.request(self.pty), &self.opts).await\n    }\n\n    fn request(&self, pty: Option<PtySize>) -> Request {\n        let mut req = self.req.clone();\n        req.mode = match pty {\n            Some(size) => Mode::Pty(size),\n            None => Mode::Pipe,\n        };\n        req"
      },
      {
        "start_line": 116,
        "end_line": 126,
        "quote": "    /// Cancels the run when `token` is cancelled: the tree is stopped and the reason is `Aborted`.\n    pub fn cancel_on(&mut self, token: CancellationToken) -> &mut Self {\n        self.opts.cancel = Some(token);\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// `true` (default): output as UTF-8 text (`Data::Text`); `false`: raw bytes (`Data::Bytes`), lossless.\n    pub fn text(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut Self {\n        self.opts.text = yes;\n        self\n    }"
      },
      {
        "start_line": 140,
        "end_line": 150,
        "quote": "    /// `run()` only: written to stdin, which is then closed (pipe mode).\n    pub fn input(&mut self, data: impl Into<Vec<u8>>) -> &mut Self {\n        self.opts.input = Some(data.into());\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// `run()` only: per-stream limit (default 16 MiB); above it `run()` fails with `OutputLimit`.\n    pub fn max_output_bytes(&mut self, bytes: usize) -> &mut Self {\n        self.opts.max_output_bytes = bytes;\n        self\n    }"
      }
    ],

Value types live in `types` (the bottom layer); behavior types next to the\n//! module that implements them; this module is the table of contents.\n\nmod command;\n\npub use crate::io::{Lines, Output};\npub use crate::process::{Child, PipeChild, PtyChild};\npub use crate::types::{Chunk, Data, DroppedBytes, Exit, Line, ProcessInfo, PtySize, Reason, RunOutput, Stdin, Stream};\npub use command::Command;\npub use tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken;"

    "kind": "implementation",
    "disposition": "analyzed",
    "purpose": "Translates dynamic-language numeric options into Rust-safe values and configures the supervisor path.",
    "behavior": [
      "millis accepts finite nonnegative numbers through u32 milliseconds and rounds fractional durations upward.",
      "byte_limit requires a nonnegative integral value below 2^64 that fits usize; pty_side requires an integer 1..32767.",
      "supervisor forwards configuration to client; embedded tests cover NaN, infinities, negatives, fractions and upper bounds."
    ],
    "contracts": [
      "Negative zero is accepted as zero; error text uses language-facing Infinity spellings.",
      "Configured supervisor takes precedence and is constrained once a different supervisor starts."
    ],
    "dependencies": [

      "src/client::configure_supervisor owns configuration lifetime."
    ],
    "failures_or_limits": [

    "evidence": [
      {
        "start_line": 25,
        "end_line": 54,
        "quote": "/// `timeoutMs` / `graceMs`: finite, from 0 to 4294967295; a fraction rounds up to the next millisecond.\npub fn millis(field: &str, value: f64) -> Result<Duration, Error> {\n    // NaN fails both comparisons; -0.0 counts as 0.\n    if value >= 0.0 && value.ceil() <= MAX_MS {\n        Ok(Duration::from_millis(value.ceil() as u64))\n    } else {\n        Err(Error::duration_out_of_range(field, shown(value)))\n    }\n}\n\n/// `maxOutputBytes`: an integer from 0.\npub fn byte_limit(field: &str, value: f64) -> Result<usize, Error> {\n    // NaN and the infinities fail the comparison or have a NaN fraction; `usize` may be narrower than `u64`.\n    if value >= 0.0\n        && value.fract() == 0.0\n        && value < TWO_POW_64\n        && let Ok(bytes) = usize::try_from(value as u64)\n    {\n        return Ok(bytes);\n    }\n    Err(Error::bad_byte_limit(field, shown(value)))\n}\n\n/// `pty.cols` / `pty.rows`: an integer from 1 to 32767.\npub fn pty_side(field: &str, value: f64) -> Result<u16, Error> {\n    if value.fract() == 0.0 && (1.0..=32767.0).contains(&value) {\n        Ok(value as u16)\n    } else {\n        Err(Error::bad_pty_size(field, shown(value)))\n    }"
      },
      {
        "start_line": 78,
        "end_line": 95,
        "quote": "    #[test]\n    fn millis_are_finite_non_negative_and_round_up() {\n        assert_eq!(millis(\"timeoutMs\", 0.0).unwrap(), Duration::ZERO);\n        assert_eq!(millis(\"timeoutMs\", -0.0).unwrap(), Duration::ZERO);\n        assert_eq!(millis(\"timeoutMs\", 0.001).unwrap(), Duration::from_millis(1));\n        assert_eq!(millis(\"graceMs\", 1500.2).unwrap(), Duration::from_millis(1501));\n        assert_eq!(\n            millis(\"timeoutMs\", MAX_MS).unwrap(),\n            Duration::from_millis(4_294_967_295)\n        );\n        refused(millis(\"timeoutMs\", MAX_MS + 0.5), \"timeoutMs is 4294967295.5;\");\n        refused(millis(\"timeoutMs\", f64::NAN), \"timeoutMs is NaN;\");\n        refused(millis(\"graceMs\", f64::INFINITY), \"graceMs is Infinity;\");\n        refused(millis(\"graceMs\", f64::NEG_INFINITY), \"graceMs is -Infinity;\");\n        refused(millis(\"timeoutMs\", -1.0), \"timeoutMs is -1;\");\n        refused(\n            millis(\"timeoutMs\", -0.5),\n            \"timeoutMs is -0.5; it must be a number of milliseconds from 0\","
      }

  {
    "path": "native/omni/crates/hugr-omni/src/client/channel.rs",
    "git_blob_sha": "7e47de8854dd70471bdde4ed94974e53ab494583",
    "source_sha256": "b68784f859ee9387720b8942a5821af41db720faf81423ba938384301c22bf15",
    "source_bytes": 13324,
    "line_count": 386,
    "kind": "implementation",
    "disposition": "analyzed",
    "purpose": "Owns one supervisor generation, serial request admission, bounded waiters and terminal failure.",
    "behavior": [
      "Registers each waiter and writes/queues its frame under the same mutex; async requests receive watched deadlines and Stop adds grace to its budget.",
      "Normal requests are rejected at 1024 pending while cleanup can use capacity through 8192; exhausting all capacity kills the generation.",
      "Ready and synchronous round trips are bounded; death clears queues and deadlines, closes the channel, aborts workers, wakes all pending replies with Io and marks trees lost."
    ],
    "contracts": [
      "Request submission checks the host PID through home() before incrementing its request ID or mutating request state; forget() directly removes a local tree entry without its own home check.",
      "No framing interleave and no reply-before-registration race; user wakeups occur outside the state lock."
    ],
    "dependencies": [
      "client/channel/route.rs drives reader/writer/deadline tasks.",
      "The platform Chan provides close and identity-checked termination; Unix identity checks are implemented in client/keeper.rs."
    ],
    "failures_or_limits": [
      "When required supervisor identity is unavailable, generation failure reports possible abandonment and the keeper declines to signal.",
      "Distinct from abandonment, macOS keeper.rs checks the exit watch and start time then signals the PID; its documented check-to-signal interval can still permit PID reuse (lines 229–244)."
    ],
    "evidence": [
      {
        "start_line": 277,
        "end_line": 307,
        "quote": "        self.home()?;\n        let req = self.next.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n        let msg = msg(req);\n        let budget = match &msg {\n            Msg::Stop { grace_ms, .. } => self.bound + Duration::from_millis(u64::from(*grace_ms)),\n            _ => self.bound,\n        };\n        let mut bytes = Vec::new();\n        encode(&msg, &mut bytes).map_err(|e| Error::request_too_big(&e))?;\n        let failed = {\n            let mut st = lock(&self.st);\n            if st.dead.is_some() {\n                drop(st);\n                return Err(self.gone());\n            }\n            let n = st.pending.len();\n            if class == Class::Normal && n >= ADMIT_NORMAL {\n                return Err(Error::supervisor_saturated(n, ADMIT_NORMAL));\n            }\n            if n >= ADMIT_ALL {\n                Some(format!(\"it stopped draining its channel ({n} requests waiting)\"))\n            } else {\n                let due = (!matches!(to, Waiter::Sync(_))).then(|| (Instant::now() + budget, budget));\n                if let Some((at, _)) = due {\n                    st.dues.insert((at, req));\n                    if st.armed.is_none_or(|armed| at < armed) {\n                        self.sooner.notify_one();\n                    }\n                }\n                st.pending.insert(req, Pending { want, id, to, due });\n                self.send(&mut st, Out { bytes, sent: 0, fds }).err()"
      },
      {
        "start_line": 340,
        "end_line": 375,
        "quote": "    /// Ends this generation: every waiter gets `Io`, the channel closes (a live supervisor then stops\n    /// every tree, as on host death; one that does not exit within `bound` is killed by identity, or, where\n    /// its identity cannot be checked, left running and named in the error), and later calls fail at once.\n    /// Never blocks.\n    pub(super) fn die(&self, why: String) {\n        let why = match self.chan.can_end() {\n            true => why,\n            false => format!(\n                \"{why}; should it not exit, it is abandoned: its identity cannot be checked here (no pidfd on \\\n                 Linux, no start time on macOS), so ending it could hit another process\"\n            ),\n        };\n        let (pending, trees, tasks, hello) = {\n            let mut st = lock(&self.st);\n            if st.dead.is_some() {\n                return;\n            }\n            st.dead = Some(why);\n            st.out.clear();\n            st.dues.clear();\n            let tasks = mem::take(&mut st.tasks);\n            (\n                mem::take(&mut st.pending),\n                mem::take(&mut st.trees),\n                tasks,\n                st.hello.take(),\n            )\n        };\n        self.chan.close(self.bound);\n        tasks.iter().for_each(AbortHandle::abort);\n        drop(hello);\n        for p in pending.into_values() {\n            deliver(p.to, Err(self.gone()));\n        }\n        for life in trees.values() {\n            life.send_modify(|l| l.lost = true);"
      },
      {
        "start_line": 214,
        "end_line": 221,
        "quote": "    /// True in the process that started this generation; false in a forked copy (R6).\n    pub(super) fn at_home(&self) -> bool {\n        std::process::id() == self.home\n    }\n\n    pub(super) fn home(&self) -> Result<(), Error> {\n        super::check_home(self.home)\n    }"
      },
      {
        "start_line": 261,
        "end_line": 264,
        "quote": "    /// The host dropped its handle: a later `Exited` for `id` is ignored.\n    pub(super) fn forget(&self, id: u64) {\n        lock(&self.st).trees.remove(&id);\n    }"
      }
    ],
